summary: Verified new bookmark feature (localStorage) + mobile responsive nav. All flows pass on desktop 1280 and mobile 390.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified: (1) AU card bookmark button (top-right overlay) toggles without navigating - URL stays on /aus. (2) filter-saved label updates to 'Saved (1)'. (3) localStorage key 'haneulz_bookmarks' stores array of IDs, persists across reload. (4) Saved filter shows only bookmarked AUs; empty state shows data-testid='au-empty' with message 'No bookmarks yet — tap the 🔖 on any AU to save it here.'. (5) Detail page pill (variant='pill') switches Bookmark<->Saved and updates localStorage. (6) Toast top-center via global Toaster appears. (7) Mobile 390px: desktop nav hidden, mobile-menu-toggle visible, mobile-menu opens with all 5 mobile-nav-* links + mobile-nav-cta, clicking a link navigates and closes menu. (8) No horizontal overflow on /, /aus, /about, /variety, /submit (scrollWidth=innerWidth=390 on all). Hero buttons wrap correctly.
